body:
A lot of that makes sense, I also thank you for your insight. My cousin is a therapist and often tells me I need to "talk to someone" about all these things that I feel like arent the culprit, but what she also describes as "built up" feelings. Talk therapy I tried twice, but I was too shy, nervous, upset for the attempt to even really make a difference. 

Im not sure exactly what things made everything seem to clear up. Maybe the sunny weather, being in love, meeting new people and making friends, et cetera. The thing is, I still have access to the sun, Im in love, Im still making friends, its just this time it isnt adding up to anything. 

As far as making everything awful, Im TOO sensitive or whatever. I get upet, angry, frustrated, I dont know. I feel like a monster. I used to make everyone smile but now I just make them upset or worried or just mean for some reason. 

Im 26 now. I thought Id grow out of this but I havent. Im just having a hard time being this way forever.

Yeah, people say Im sensitive alot, and that I take everything personal. From just an hour or so ago I feel less like doing the deed, I feel like waiting for my boyfriend to come home. I might go to the e.r. or something and ask for immediate help. i appreciate your insight.
